summary: Vertical Aerospace Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing the resignation of Chairman Dómhnal Slattery effective May 12, 2026, and the appointment of Ben Story as interim Chairman. Slattery, who served from January 2025 (and previously from 2022-2023), stepped down after the company achieved key milestones including a piloted transition flight and a financing package of up to $850 million. Story, a former Rolls-Royce executive and investment banker, will lead the board until a permanent chair is named. No financial terms or advisors are mentioned. Watch for board succession and ongoing strategic execution.
